file_roles.evidence: Item_direct_view_ref::derived_field_transformer_for_where returns '(*ref)' instead of 'this', so the ref wrapper is stripped; commit says the expression was pushed into the derived table incorrectly.

rationale: The crash is in add_key_field during optimization (Bitmap::merge), but the bad pushed-down expression is created by the transformer in item.cc. The one-line change there corrects it.
